title: Procedural BIM Module
description: Add a new flow module `bim` (Building Information Modeling) that contributes semantic building-model schemas and operators, fully wired into the flow/procedural toolchain, so future modules like energy and structure can consume a building model.
summary: Added flow module `bim` for semantic building information modeling: schemas (material, space, wall, slab, column, window, story, building), element constructors, story/building assembly operators, and floor-area/gross-volume measures. Wired into Cargo workspace, flow_core registry, FlowExtensionHost loaders/defaults, build scripts, vitest/vite aliases, launch.json, and procedural integration test for end-to-end wall→story→building→measure evaluation.
